snippet.title: Bejeweled 2 Deluxe (2004) - 100% Puzzle Mode Playthrough
snippet.description:
Haven't played this in almost 15 years.

Got a bit puzzled (no pun intended) toward the end there and started getting lazy; hence why I kinda spammed the "HINT" button so many times. A walkthrough IS a walkthrough, and I don't give a care too much on memorizing buzzles of nearly a 20 year old game. :P

Get it from Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3300/Bejeweled_2_Deluxe/
